# Josh McCartney

> Dubai-based public speaking coach, keynote speaker and MC, and two-time TEDx speaker. Founder of THRIVE by Josh McCartney (since 2019). Trains teams and leaders at companies including Nokia, Adidas and Forbes Global Properties to present, pitch and communicate with confidence. Over 700,000 TikTok followers.

## Topics
Communication and how it shapes the way people think and act; leadership communication; selling from the stage; memory techniques. Also MC and host for corporate events, conferences and awards nights.

## TEDx talks
- How Communication Shapes Your Reality, TEDxDGPS Youth (2025): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vYhfWH2Vh8g
- Memory Techniques, TEDxAlQuoz (October 2021): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t7-3W7u9xoQ

## Work with Josh
- Keynotes
- Public speaking and presentation skills training (three days)
- Selling from the stage, for business owners
- One-to-one talk coaching for experts, founders and thought leaders
- Event host and MC

## Background
Bachelor of Music, Queensland University of Technology. Former resident entertainer at Anantara Dubai Palm Jumeirah and General Manager of Event Central (entertainment for five-star hotels and corporate clients).
